newsitem.title: USA: Playtex Products expects to take charge.
newsitem.headline: Playtex Products expects to take charge.

text.p: Playtex Products Inc said Monday that it has refinanced its $470 million in bank debt with a new $320 million senior credit facility and $150 million in unsecured Senior Notes.

Commenting on the refinancing, Michael Gallagher, chief executive officer said, "This refinancing will greatly add to our ability to execute our growth plans. In particular, our acquisition capabilities are significantly enhanced with the reduction in our required principal payments over the next five years by more than $300 million."

The personal care products company said in a statement that it expects to take an after-tax write-off of approximately $4.1 million, or $.08 per share, in the third quarter of 1997 associated with the deferred financing costs from the prior credit agreement.
